Scalar-dilation invariance makes the optimizer line-wise uniform; character orthogonality gives the exact moment (1). Complete equality cases follow from uniqueness and modulation. The standalone checker passed 3015 supplementary tests on eight prime/prime-power fields. The infinite assertion rests on the proof, not the finite trials.
